mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY S.CREATED_TIME DESC) AS rnum, S.sale_item_id, S.judge_kind_name, S.cut_name, S.title, S.description, S.weight, S.price, S.grade, I.IMAGE_ID, I.IMAGE_URL, U.user_name FROM SALES S LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_IMAGES I ON S.sale_item_id = I.PRODUCT_ID AND I.IS_THUMBNAIL = 'y' INNER JOIN USERS U ON S.seller_id = U.id WHERE S.judge_kind_name = #{kind} AND S.cut_name = #{part} AND S.sale_status = 'ON' ) WHERE rnum BETWEEN #{pageable.offset} + 1 AND #{pageable.offset} + #{pageable.size} ORDER BY SALE_ITEM_ID ASC

SELECT S.sale_item_id, S.qty, S.title, S.description, S.weight, S.price, S.grade, S.judge_kind_name, S.cut_name, S.traceability_num, I.image_id, I.image_url, I.order_index FROM SALES S INNER JOIN PRODUCT_IMAGES I ON S.sale_item_id = I.product_id WHERE S.sale_item_id = #{saleId}
